title: Earnings Integrity — Duplicate Mileage Postings on Cartwise Shopper Batches and the Duplicate-Pay Reversal Tool
content:
When the mileage component stands twice among a batch's pay postings on Cartwise Shopper Batches, the second posting is a duplicate and the desk takes it back with one reversal on the duplicate-pay ground, within the clawback window and at most once for that posting.

## The recovery at a glance

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| What is a duplicate | The second of two mileage pay postings standing on the same batch |
| Who takes it back | The desk |
| How | One reversal on the duplicate-pay ground, against that later posting |
| When | Within the batch type's clawback window counted from the batch's completion |
| How often | At most once for that posting |

A batch with a single mileage posting has no duplicate. A mileage posting that already carries a reversal is not reversed again.

## Situation of use and capability of `reverse_duplicate_pay_33b66c45`

`reverse_duplicate_pay_33b66c45` takes back pay that was credited twice on a shopper batch. One call books a single pay reversal on the named batch against the one pay entry it names, with the ground duplicate pay and today's date, and lowers the batch's earnings by the amount taken back; the reversal appears at once among the batch's earnings entries and in the shopper's pay breakdown.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reverse_duplicate_pay_33b66c45` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `batch_id` | The batch number of the shopper batch the reversal is booked on, as returned by the batch lookup for the verified shopper | Id |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the pay entry being taken back, as returned by the batch earnings-entry lookup for that batch | Id |
| `amount_usd` | The amount taken back, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent by the caller; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

The ground of the reversal is not a parameter: every reversal this tool books carries the duplicate-pay ground.

## Return

A text receipt of a dictionary carrying `batch_event_id` (the reference number of the reversal entry), `batch_id`, `source_event_id` (the pay entry taken back), `reversal_reason` (always `duplicate_pay`), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `batch_earnings_usd` (the batch's earnings once the reversal is booked). Receiving the `batch_event_id` means the reversal is booked.
